crossRefs.note: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.
You who love Yahweh, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.
Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be gracious…
Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
Abstain from every form of evil.
However God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal, “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who…
There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
“Don’t keep talking so exceedingly proudly. Don’t let arrogance come out of your mouth, for Yahweh is a God of…
For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.
The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.
For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.
and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor, and love no false oath: for all these are things…
Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject…
Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.
A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,
The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.

translations.web: The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
translations.bsb: To fear the LORD is to hate evil; I hate arrogant pride, evil conduct, and perverse speech.
translations.kjv: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.
translations.asv: The fear of Jehovah is to hate evil: Pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, And the perverse mouth, do I hate.
